frequency_question: How often do advance observable liquidity contractions or credit growth signals precede a repo rate hike within the subsequent policy meetings?
membership_rule: Members are all Monetary Policy Committee meetings of the central bank during active tightening cycles since 2011 where rate hikes were announced versus total meetings.
provenance_note: claims 35 cases from only 3 named (11.7x); beyond 3.0x the skeleton is not carrying the estimate
coverage_note: 35 named meeting instances across 3 distinct tightening cycles; captures all structural tightening interventions since 2011.
known_gaps: Does not account for unprecedented external shocks outside standard macro cycles.
skeleton: Total MPC meetings in modern tightening cycles (approx 35 meetings across 3 cycles) where advance indicators (inflation persistence, credit expansion) were present, yielding rate hikes in roughly 40% of those specific meetings.
validity_reason: Central bank reaction functions and monetary policy frameworks remain stable over multi-year horizons barring major legislative overhauls.
